claims.scope: Exact rank-one cross block between two disjoint original-coordinate product banks; arbitrary measurable same-bank functions; dimension-free square-root small-ball estimate. Later account01/B04 r20 proves a stronger rank-free first-compound theorem on this scope.
Original physical invertible indefinite pair plus exact rank-one Schur crossing; essential L-infinity bound. Later account01/B04 r20 removes the rank restriction.

In B08 r45 common-plane geometry with invertible indefinite physical pair, the exact pair-Schur cross block N=M1^T(R_c-B^{-1})M2+T obeys ||N||_F^2=||M1^T(R_c-B^{-1})M2||_F^2+||T||_F^2 and is paid by account01/B04 r20 whenever N is nonzero.
With full-row-rank arms and P1TP2=0, the pair-Schur crossing N vanishes iff R_c=B^{-1} and T=0.

not_claimed: No closure of the exact Schur-match / zero-tail surface R_c=B^{-1}, T=0.
No closure of singular or near-singular physical hub pairs.
